name: S/PDIF optical (TOSLINK)

policy._this_is_a_policy: What to assume when the device has said nothing - not a measurement. A record that knows its own real figure wins.

note: The most restrictive input in common use, and the one that most often surprises a listener: the same converter that takes 768 kHz over USB may stop here at 96. Many modules reach 192; see _conservative_not_measured.
